song.title: Turning Invisible
song.description: An instrumental from 2009. Lyrics recovered from a 2015 email. Two pieces of the past, brought together in a 2026 AI mix. MusicSubject × Call Me Daddy.

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
Worked for twenty-seven seconds
Then the room went quiet again
[Verse 1]
You held your memories out in both hands
He let them fall like coins in the sand
You gave him patience, he gave you the ache
Now every old picture starts losing its shape
[Chorus]
You’re turning invisible
The sight of it’s miserable
You’re fading away
From his memories
Your tears changed who you was
So you could feel okay
And how you felt about him starts to fade
[Verse 2 — Featured Artist]
I saw your name on the back of a receipt
Folded in the pocket of your old blue jeans
You said, “I’m getting better,” then you looked away
Some goodbyes take a little longer than they say
Let the past keep talking; you don’t have to stay
You can leave the door shut and still be okay
[Chorus]
You’re turning invisible
The sight of it’s miserable
You’re fading away
From his memories
Your tears changed who you was
So you could feel okay
And how you felt about him starts to fade
[Outro]
Starts to fade
Starts to fade
lyrics.snippet: Let the past keep talking; you don’t have to stay
